gloss: power outage; power cut; disconnection of electricity

definitions.gloss: power outage; power cut; disconnection of electricity
definitions.explanation: The interruption or cutting off of electrical power supply, whether planned (for maintenance) or unplanned (due to a fault or disaster).

examples.japanese: ⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{断電|だんでん}⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Power will be cut for construction work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{断電|だんでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}した→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧。
examples.english: A power outage occurred due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {断電|だんでん}⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{非常用|ひじょうよう}→非常用：28550_hijouyou⟧⟦{発電機|はつでんき}→発電機：29732_hatsudenki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{作動|さどう}→作動：11692_sadou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The emergency generator activates during a power outage.

notes:
A somewhat technical word used in official notices, utility communications, and infrastructure contexts. More formal than the everyday ⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧, and emphasizes the deliberate or mechanical cutting of power rather than a general outage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {断電|だんでん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cut power
- {断電|だんでん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発生|はっせい}する→発生する：25529_hasseisuru⟧: a power cut occurs
- {断電|だんでん}⟦{時|じ}→時：09869_ji⟧: during a power outage
- {計画|けいかく}{断電|だんでん}: planned power cut

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧: power outage; blackout — the everyday word for power going out
- ⟦{送電|そうでん}→送電：17225_souden⟧: power transmission — the delivery of electrical power
- ⟦{通電|つうでん}→通電：30050_tsuuden⟧: energization; passing current — the opposite: electricity flowing through
